report_name: Weak eMudhra Certificate Keys Force Emergency Browser Blocks

vulnerabilities.name: Weak Private Key Generation in eMudhra Certificates
vulnerabilities.description: A flaw in eMudhra's key generation process for eight P-384 elliptic-curve intermediate certificates resulted in critically low entropy (3 to 8 bits). This allowed for the trivial recovery of private keys, enabling potential man-in-the-middle attacks and certificate forgery. The private key for the 'EM OV TLS CA - G3C' certificate was found to be the single digit '4'.

identities.name: eMudhra
identities.description: Indian Certificate Authority (CA) that issued eight intermediate TLS certificates with critically weak private keys due to a flaw in their key generation process in April 2025.

identities.name: Mozilla
identities.description: Browser vendor that took emergency action to revoke trust in the compromised eMudhra certificates.

identities.description: Browser and OS vendor that took emergency action to revoke trust in the compromised eMudhra certificates.
